initial:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit THIS SINGLE authoritative first-floor overview, do not generate an alternative layout. Preserve exact camera, footprint, TOP bedroom row, cleared open lobby in front of office, tiny office, kitchen two round tables, outer walls, room boundaries, whole-floor composition, light and material palette. User requests TWO SPECIFIC FIXES, no room swaps.
FIX A — REVERSE ORIENTATION OF TOILETS AND SHOWER CUBICLES, not their rooms: Toilet room stays immediately right of kitchen; shower room stays immediately right of toilet. In source their cubicle fronts appear blocked and fixtures look reversed. Rebuild the three toilet cubicles and four shower cubicles in the same BOTTOM strips of their respective rooms so the OPEN ENTRANCES all face UP/NORTH toward each room's central interior aisle and its corridor entrance. Their SOLID BACK WALLS are against the OUTER BOTTOM/SOUTH building wall. Toilet cisterns/backs must be against that bottom outer wall, toilet bowls projecting UP/NORTH toward the open cubicle doors and aisle. Keep sinks along left wall of toilet room. Shower plumbing, mixers and showerheads mounted on cubicle BACK walls against the BOTTOM outer wall; glass/frosted swinging doors at TOP/NORTH of each shower bay, facing central aisle. Show every cubicle door swung OPEN along side divider so the entry gaps are clearly open, not a solid barricade. Do not put a full solid partition running across the top mouths of cubicles. Each cubicle has sidewalls for privacy but clear front gap and threshold. The change should VISIBLY reverse the old facing and make access from upper aisle sensible. Keep the main separate toilet and shower room corridor doors exactly where they are. NO swap of room positions. No toilets in showers, no showers in toilet room.
FIX B — REAR STOREROOM BELOW THE OFFICE, at extreme LOWER LEFT: currently the open door at its right edge seems to lead into a blocked pocket. Retain this same storeroom and doorway location. Remove the small interior return wall/pier and any shelf immediately behind that doorway. Make a WIDE CLEAR DOOR OPENING around100cm in the storeroom's RIGHT wall, with a dark wood door leaf swung fully inward flat against adjacent inner wall, away from view and walking path. From the short side access aisle one must be able to see INTO THE ROOM LEFTWARD unobstructed. At least1.2x1.2m clear FLOOR immediately inside this door. Move existing low shelves and storage crates to the far LEFT corner/bottom-left wall, leaving the center and right half EMPTY. Cut the doorway's near jamb down if needed so the cutaway view shows the actual OPEN GAP, do not replace doorway with a label. Keep the office above it unchanged, do not add a corridor behind it. Keep this back storeroom distinct from the TWO compartments already removed in front of office; those front compartments MUST remain absent with continuous green lobby.

Add one small unobtrusive callout pointing INTO the clear rear-room doorway '창고 진입 · 안쪽 비움'. Small label between toilet/shower aisle if room '부스 입구 → 실내 통로'. Header '1층 · 통합 수정 시안'. No additional panels or detail insets. This exact whole-floor image will be the ONLY master, and zoom will use the same file. Retain all other existing useful labels and details. Realistic 3D textured architectural cutaway, not a flat blueprint. Show changes physically.

TOILET ROOM immediately LEFT of shower: source inadvertently has FOUR toilets. It must have THREE toilet cubicles, same total width, wider equal cubicles. Three cisterns against BOTTOM outer wall, bowls pointing toward TOP/aisle, three OPEN front doors. Keep left sinks and top aisle unchanged. Do not replace bowls with shower fixtures.
REAR STOREROOM below office at extreme lower left: door exists at its RIGHT side. Remove the narrow interior partition stub just LEFT of the open doorway that visually blocks path into storage. Maintain an obvious 100cm opening in right wall into room, door leaf open alongside wall, EMPTY clear central floor, shelving only at left far end. Do not modify clear lobby, bedroom row, kitchen, office, walls elsewhere, stairs, or title. No new reference panels or closeups. This is final corrected SINGLE MASTER OVERVIEW, not comparison. Keep style and materials identical.
